newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Sec to stop lending Yaohan shares.
newsitem.headline: Japan Sec to stop lending Yaohan shares.

text.p: Japan Securities Finance Co Ltd (JSF) said Friday that it would stop accepting orders to borrow shares of Yaohan Japan Corp for margin transactions.

JSF said the move would be effective from Monday. JSF is Japan's largest securities financing company and lends shares to brokerages for margin transactions with the authorisation of the Finance Ministry.
In recent months, Yaohan's shares have been volatile due to worries about the financial health of the company.
The supermarket chain operator announced a restructuring plan earlier in the year.
On Friday, its share fell 14 yen to 203 in trade totalling 6.4 million shares. It was the second most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
